roster_contacts.description: List of contacts to automatically add to new users' rosters upon registration. Each contact has a JID and optional name and groups.

jid.description: The JID (Jabber ID) of the contact to add (e.g., admin@example.com).

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the contact (e.g., 'Support Team').

groups.description: Optional list of roster groups this contact should appear under.
